description:
Plug the F# mapper into the dispatcher so files with `.fs`/`.fsx`/`.fsi` extensions get routed correctly.

Files
- `src/ocaml/lib/catseye_ast/types.ml` — add `FSharp` to the `lang` variant.
- `src/ocaml/lib/catseye_ast/parse.ml`:
  - Extend `lang_of_extension` to map `.fs`, `.fsx`, `.fsi` to `Some FSharp`.
  - Add the `| FSharp -> Fsharp_mapper.parse_file ~path` branch in the dispatch match.
- `src/ocaml/lib/catseye_ast/plugin_registry.ml` — no changes needed if `parse_via_registry` already works; verify by reading. (If we want the new plugin auto-registered, the wiring point lives in `catseye_cli`/`catseye_engine`; check during the impl.)

Acceptance
- `Lang.to_string` (or whatever the pretty-printer is called) covers F#.
- `parse.ml` test (or a smoke run) successfully parses a `.fs` file via the new branch.
- No regression in any existing language's dispatch.

Blocked by: catseye-9mh.4.
Worktree: `catseye-9mh.5/wire-fsharp-dispatch`.
title: Wire F# into parse.ml + types.ml + plugin registry
